# awesome-game-design — Roobyx (curated discovery index)

- Type: LINK ONLY card (the value is the list itself; we install primary sources, not lists of links).
- Source: https://github.com/Roobyx/awesome-game-design — CC-BY-4.0, ★696, actively maintained (verified via GitHub API 2026-10-26: pushed 2026-10-23).
- What it is: a human-curated index of game-design books, articles, talks, and tools across design theory, balance, UI/UX, level design, and production.

## How our flow uses it

First stop when a design question has no card in `game-design/` yet: find the canonical source there, then write a proper card (or full copy, if the license allows) instead of citing the list. If this index and our library disagree on what the canonical source is, prefer the one we can verify and summarize.
